statement: An effect that targets a player says so to what responds to that (Mystical Refpanel, Muko).
question: Which effects target a player (a draw, damage)? It is decided card by card: the closest thing to a rule is the list of cards Mystical Refpanel can respond to.
meanwhile: RML has no flag for it: no effect targets a player.
scripts: The scripts of 41 cards that read flag a draw or damage as targeting a player (PLAYER_TARGET).
